top_signals.title: Rains Ease El Niño Crop Fears in Brazil’s Top Soybean Region
top_signals.summary: A sea of vigorous, leafy green plants deep inside Brazil’s top soybean region is easing fears that El Niño would bring crop losses to the world’s top producer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
